labels.variantDefinition: Multi-column footer with links (foundry, socials, info, legal)
labels.look: Photo of a flexing torso above a red band with small multi-column links
labels.learn: The closing photo keeps the joke going right to the end

labels.variantDefinition: Credits and colophon: designers, contributors, testers, tools, fonts used on the site
labels.look: Teal, grouped name lists with linked studios, emoji-like icons
labels.learn: Crediting beta testers and advisors shows the community behind the font

labels.variantDefinition: Informal closing note from the designer (email me, thanks, ASCII art), personal rather than corporate
labels.look: White, monospace/pixel text, ASCII rules, kaomoji
labels.learn: A personal note suits a one-person, free, community font

labels.variantDefinition: One or two prominent buttons (buy, trial, download) linking to an external shop, distributor or repository
labels.look: Charcoal, two large outlined circles 'BUY' and 'DOWNLOAD TRIAL FONTS'; black/white site toggle
labels.ux: Two CTAs; site theme toggle (black site / white site)
labels.learn: Giving trial equal weight to buy lowers the barrier

labels.look: White, small serif credits, one slate-blue 'PURCHASE MONTECATINI PRO' button
labels.learn: Credits right above the button add provenance at the moment of decision

labels.look: Black, 'Get the font', pill buttons for Google Fonts and GitHub
labels.learn: For free fonts the 'checkout' is choosing a distribution channel

labels.look: Second state of the hero: katakana with strike-through lines
labels.ux: Scrolling changes the axis; this is a later wheel frame
labels.learn: Wheel-driven specimens produce distinct states worth showing as a sequence

labels.variantDefinition: Email field and subscribe button, usually with a privacy note
labels.look: Dark, red subscribe button, privacy note in serif

labels.variantDefinition: A large closing statement or name at the end of the page, followed by small legal lines
labels.look: Black, white letterspaced 'NOW AVAILABLE ON YOUR SCREEN', tiny © and imprint
labels.learn: End with a line that echoes the opening: the page closes like a film
